articles.title: Ringgit opens higher against major currencies, softer vs US$
articles.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The ringgit opened higher against most major currencies on Friday but eased against the US dollar as markets turned risk-off, with crude oil prices continuing to climb and the Trump administration stepping up its trade protectionist policies.

articles.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
articles.description: Domestic equities extended losses for a fourth consecutive session, with the Nifty declining. Investor sentiment remained fragile amid a sharp surge in Brent crude oil prices. Foreign portfolio investors net sold shares worth Rs 2,999 crore on Wednesday. The rupee traded in a narrow range, appreciating marginally by around 0.05%. Analysts suggest Indian equities are likely to remain under pressure in the near term.

articles.title: Gas, groceries and back-to-school items to spike with higher oil prices

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks fall on tech selloff, oil trades above $100
articles.description: Asian stocks declined following a Wall Street tech selloff and investor doubts about artificial intelligence returns. Oil prices held their gains after closing over one hundred dollars, reaching a May high. Treasuries fell and the dollar strengthened as inflation and interest rate hike concerns grew. US President Donald Trump's threats intensified conflict worries after Houthi militants attacked oil tankers. These events fueled concerns over potential disruptions to global energy supplies.

articles.title: Dollar rides yield surge as Middle East and trade wars raise inflation stakes
articles.description: The dollar rode U.S. Treasury yields higher on Friday and hovered near a 40-year peak against the yen, as a ​spike in oil prices and a renewed global trade war raised the stakes for inflation.

articles.title: Resurgent Dollar Leads to Global Economic Ripples Amid Trade Tensions
articles.description: The dollar rose with U.S. Treasury yields, nearing a 40-year high against the yen amid climbing oil prices and trade tensions. These factors, alongside new tariffs announced by the Trump administration, heightened fears of inflation. The economic turbulence affected various currencies and central bank strategies.

articles.title: Trump threatens 'major military punishment' after Houthi strike on Saudi tankers
articles.description: President Trump vowed major military punishment for Iran and its Houthi allies. Houthi fighters struck two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea. Global oil prices surged significantly after the attacks on shipping routes. Iran also reported missile strikes on U.S. military sites in Jordan and Kuwait. These escalating events raise fears of wider economic disruption and conflict.

articles.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Nifty bulls' resolve to defend 23,800 set for another test as oil crosses $100
articles.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: The Nifty is down nearly 500 points this week. Despite the adverse conditions globally due to rising oil prices, the bulls have somehow still managed to defend the 23,800 level on the downside. Thursday's low of 23,807 is proof of that. That resolve will be put to test yet again on the final trading day of the week, as Brent crude closed above $101 a barrel last night.
